basic_info.description: Welcome to this charming Outer Richmond home, ideally located just one block from Geary Boulevard's shops, restaurants, and public transit. With Balboa Street cafes, Golden Gate Park, Ocean Beach, Lincoln Park, the Legion of Honor, Sutro Heights, and the scenic Lands End trails nearby, you'll enjoy both everyday convenience and endless recreation right at your doorstep. Inside, the home offers a spacious living room centered around a classic fireplace, a formal dining room perfect for gatherings, and a large kitchen with plentiful cabinet space. The upper level features two generous bedrooms plus a bright sunroom that can function as a third bedroom, office, or playroom, along with a full bath. An interior stairway leads to the expansive garage, providing side-by-side parking plus space for a third or even fourth car. With its impressive high ceilings, the garage presents great potential for future legal living space. An additional unwarranted quarter bath is also located here for convenience. The landscaped backyard offers room for gardening, outdoor dining, or simply relaxing in the coastal air. Combining classic San Francisco charm with expansion possibilities, this home is truly a rare find.
